scene: The blossom safely tucked away, three garden transit gates unlock together.
picture: A flat side view along a polished garden concourse. On the far left, a glass-roofed trolley waits on illuminated rails. Left of centre, the player in lilac headscarf and mustard coat pats her glowing brown satchel. At centre, a spiraling glass lift door glides open. On the far right hangs a mountain cable tram.
shown: a sleek glass-roofed trolley resting on tracks at the far left
an ornate spiral glass elevator with glowing gears at centre
a suspended mountain cable tram hooked to high cables on the far right
